title: Extract fallback saga and reduce regional routing footprint
creator: Liam Chen
description:
Current smart-router mixes fallback orchestration, regional lease bookkeeping, and routing heuristics in a single hotpath module. This has led to:
- increased contention on routing locks during bursts,
- duplicated state between the policy engine and region mapper,
- awkward feature gates for staged rollouts (canary fallback policies), and
- difficulty reasoning about long-running fallback transitions.

Goal: Extract a narrow "fallback saga" service (library + small event stream) that becomes the canonical executor for multi-step fallback flows while slimming the regional routing hotpath to only perform fast decision evaluation and shard selection. The extraction should reduce lock contention, make rollback/observability of fallback flows explicit, and enable independent scaling of fallback orchestration logic.
acceptance_criteria: All fallback transitions are executed through the new fallback saga API (no duplicated state mutations in the routing hotpath)
Regional routing hotpath latency p50 reduced by >= 20% under standardized load test (see perf harness)
Fallback flows have structured telemetry: start/end events, step timings, and reason codes visible in Console rollout traces
A migration plan exists and can be toggled with feature flags per-region; no customer-visible errors during gradual rollout
Unit and integration tests cover interleaved failover + regional-lease races with simulated node drops
implementation_plan: Design: produce a lightweight spec for the fallback saga DSL (steps, compensations, idempotency keys)
PoC: implement a local in-process fallback saga runner and integrate with a single route to validate semantics
Event bus: add an internal event stream topic and compacted offsets for saga state (kafka/topic or cloud equivalent)
Migration: add feature flags and a dual-write mode where hotpath emits intent and saga runs authoritative changes
Perf: remove lock-heavy operations from hotpath and replace with fast read-only checks; introduce lease snapshots
Rollout: enable per-region ramp starting with eu-west-1, monitor telemetry and revert if errors > threshold
Cleanup: delete legacy fallback code paths once saga is stable for 2 weeks across 3 regions
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: partial migration may result in split-brain transitions. Mitigation: dual-write mode with a reconciliation job and an enforced single-writer lease for a given route
Risk: added event stream latency increases overall failover time. Mitigation: compact critical steps into synchronous fast-path with async reconciliation for non-critical bookkeeping

Risk: operational complexity for debugging multi-step sagas. Mitigation: add deterministic run IDs and rich trace context to existing Console traces and a small CLI tool to replay saga history for investigation
test_plan: Unit tests for saga step idempotency, retries, and compensation logic
Integration tests that inject regional capacity failures and validate safe fallback ordering
Load tests comparing hotpath latency before/after extraction using perf-harness v3; target dataset attached
Chaos experiments (terminate node, network partition) during staged rollout in canary region
Smoke tests for observability: rollout traces must show saga steps for 100% of fallback occurrences in canary
